title: TS 24.501
heading: Equivalent PLMNs
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.7.3	Equivalent PLMNs
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.7	Registration accept] 
This IE may be included in order to assign an equivalent PLMNs list to a UE.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Allowed NSSAI
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.7.5	Allowed NSSAI
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.7	Registration accept] 
This IE shall be included:

a)	if:

1)	one or more S-NSSAIs in the requested NSSAI of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message are allowed by the AMF for a network not supporting NSSAA;

2)	one or more S-NSSAIs in the requested NSSAI of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message are not subject to network slice-specific authentication and authorization and are allowed by the AMF; or

3)	the network slice-specific authentication and authorization has been successfully performed for one or more S-NSSAIs in the requested NSSAI of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message; or

b)	if the initial registration request is not for onboarding services in SNPN or the UE is not registered for onboarding services in SNPN, the requested NSSAI was not included in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message or none of the requested NSSAI are allowed; and

1)	the network does not support NSSAA; or

2)	the network has one or more default S-NSSAIs which are not subject to network slice-specific authentication and authorization.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Rejected NSSAI
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.7.6	Rejected NSSAI
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.7	Registration accept] 
The network may include this IE to inform the UE of one or more S-NSSAIs that were included in the requested NSSAI in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message but were rejected by the network.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Configured NSSAI
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.7.7	Configured NSSAI
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.7	Registration accept] 
The network may include this IE if the network needs to provide the UE with a new configured NSSAI for the current PLMN or SNPN and the UE is neither registering nor registered for onboarding services in SNPN.

title: TS 24.501
heading: 5GS network feature support
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.7.8	5GS network feature support
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.7	Registration accept] 
The network may include this IE to inform the UE of the support of certain features. If this IE is not included then the UE shall interpret this as a receipt of an information element with all bits of the value part coded as zero.

title: TS 24.501
heading: PDU session status
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.7.9	PDU session status
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.7	Registration accept] 
This IE shall be included when the network needs to indicate the PDU sessions that are associated with the access type the message is sent over, that are active in the network.

title: TS 24.501
heading: PDU session reactivation result
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.7.10	PDU session reactivation result
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.7	Registration accept] 
This IE shall be included:

-	if the Uplink data status IE is included in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message; or

-	if the Allowed PDU session status IE is included in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message and there is at least one PDU session indicated in the Allowed PDU session status IE for which the user-plane resources can be re-established over 3GPP access.

title: TS 24.501
heading: PDU session reactivation result error cause
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.7.11	PDU session reactivation result error cause
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.7	Registration accept] 
This IE may be included, if the PDU session reactivation result IE is included and there exist one or more PDU sessions for which the user-plane resources cannot be re-established, to indicate the cause of failure to re-establish the user-plane resources.

title: TS 24.501
heading: LADN information
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.7.12	LADN information
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.7	Registration accept] 
The network shall include this IE if there are valid LADN service area(s) for the subscribed DNN(s) of the UE in the current registration area.

title: TS 24.501
heading: MICO indication
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.7.13	MICO indication
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.7	Registration accept] 
The network shall include the MICO indication IE if:

a)-	the UE included the MICO indication IE in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message; and

b)	the network supports and accepts the use of MICO mode.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Network slicing indication
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.7.14	Network slicing indication
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.7	Registration accept] 
This IE shall be included if the user's network slicing subscription has changed in the UDM of a PLMN or an SNPN.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Service area list
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.7.15	Service area list
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.7	Registration accept] 
This IE may be included to assign new service area restrictions to the UE.

title: TS 24.501
heading: T3512 value
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.7.16	T3512 value
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.7	Registration accept] 
The AMF shall include this IE during a registration procedure over 3GPP access when the 5GS registration type IE does not indicate "periodic registration updating". The AMF may include this IE during the mobility and periodic registration update procedure over 3GPP access when the 5GS registration type IE indicates "periodic registration updating".

title: TS 24.501
heading: Non-3GPP de-registration timer value
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.7.17	Non-3GPP de-registration timer value
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.7	Registration accept] 
This IE may be included if the network needs to indicate to the UE registered over non-3GPP access the value of a non-3GPP de-registration timer value.

title: TS 24.501
heading: T3502 value
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.7.18	T3502 value
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.7	Registration accept] 
This IE may be included to indicate a value for timer T3502.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Emergency number list
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.7.19	Emergency number list
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.7	Registration accept] 
This IE may be sent by the network. If this IE is sent, the contents of this IE indicates a list of emergency numbers valid within the same country as in the PLMN from which this IE is received.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Extended emergency number list
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.7.20	Extended emergency number list
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.7	Registration accept] 
This IE may be sent by the network. If this IE is sent, the contents of this IE indicates a list of emergency numbers (with URN information) valid within the same country as in the PLMN from which this IE is received or valid only in the PLMN or SNPN from which this IE is received.

title: TS 24.501
heading: EAP message
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.7.22	EAP message
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.7	Registration accept] 
EAP message IE is included if the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message is sent as part of registration for emergency services and is used to convey EAP-failure message.

title: TS 24.501
heading: NSSAI inclusion mode
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.7.23	NSSAI inclusion mode
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.7	Registration accept] 
This IE shall be included if required by operatory policy.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Operator-defined access category definitions
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.7.24	Operator-defined access category definitions
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.7	Registration accept] 
This IE may be included to assign new operator-defined access category definitions to the UE or delete the operator-defined access category definitions at the UE side.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Negotiated DRX parameters
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.7.25	Negotiated DRX parameters
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.7	Registration accept] 
The network shall include this IE if the Requested DRX parameters IE was included in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Non-3GPP NW policies
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.7.26	Non-3GPP NW policies
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.7	Registration accept] 
The AMF shall not include this IE during a registration procedure over non-3GPP access.

This IE is included if the network needs to indicate whether emergency numbers provided via non-3GPP access can be used to initiate UE detected emergency calls (see 3GPP TS 24.302 [16]). If this IE is not included then the UE shall interpret this as a receipt of an information element with all bits of the value part coded as zero.

NOTE:	In this version of the specification, this IE is applicable in case the UE is connected to a PLMN using an ePDG as specified in 3GPP TS 24.302 [16].

title: TS 24.501
heading: EPS bearer context status
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.7.26A	EPS bearer context status
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.7	Registration accept] 
This IE shall be included when the network generated an EPS bearer context status information for the UE during the inter-system change from S1 mode to N1 mode and the network supports N26 interface.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Negotiated extended DRX parameters
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.7.27	Negotiated extended DRX parameters
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.7	Registration accept] 
The network shall include the Negotiated extended DRX parameters IE if:

-	the UE included the Requested extended DRX parameters IE in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message; and

-	the network supports eDRX and accepts the use of eDRX.

title: TS 24.501
heading: T3447 value
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.7.28	T3447 value
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.7	Registration accept] 
The network may include T3447 value IE if:

-	the UE has indicated support for service gap control in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message; and

-	the 5GMM context contains a service gap time value.

title: TS 24.501
heading: T3448 value
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.7.29	T3448 value
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.7	Registration accept] 
The network may include this IE if the congestion control for transport of user data via the control plane is active and the UE supports the control plane CIoT 5GS optimizations.

title: TS 24.501
heading: T3324 value
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.7.30	T3324 value
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.7	Registration accept] 
The AMF shall include this IE if the UE has requested active time value in the REGISTRATION REQEUST message and the AMF decides to accept the use of MICO mode and the use of the active time.

title: TS 24.501
heading: UE radio capability ID
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.7.32	UE radio capability ID
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.7	Registration accept] 
This IE may be included if the UE is not in NB-N1 mode, both the UE and the network support RACS and the network needs to assign a network-assigned UE radio capability ID to the UE.

title: TS 24.501
heading: UE radio capability ID deletion indication
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.7.33	UE radio capability ID deletion indication
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.7	Registration accept] 
This IE may be included if the UE is not in NB-N1 mode, both the UE and the network support RACS and the network needs to trigger the UE to delete all network-assigned UE radio capability IDs stored at the UE for the serving PLMN or SNPN.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Pending NSSAI
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.7.34	Pending NSSAI
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.7	Registration accept] 
The network may include this IE to inform the UE of one or more S-NSSAIs that are pending as the network slice-specific authentication and authorization procedure is not completed.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Ciphering key data
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.7.35	Ciphering key data
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.7	Registration accept] 
This IE is included if the network needs to send ciphering key data to the UE for ciphered broadcast assistance data.

title: TS 24.501
heading: CAG information list
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.7.36	CAG information list
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.7	Registration accept] 
This IE may be included to assign a new "CAG information list" to the UE or delete the "CAG information list" at the UE side.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Truncated 5G-S-TMSI configuration
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.7.37	Truncated 5G-S-TMSI configuration
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.7	Registration accept] 
The network shall include this IE if:

-	the UE is in NB-N1 mode;

-	the UE requests "control plane CIoT 5GS optimization" in the 5GS update type IE of REGISTRATION REQUEST message;

-	the AMF decides to accept the requested CIoT 5GS optimization; and

-	the network is configured to provide the truncated 5G-S-TMSI configuration for control plane CIoT 5GS optimizations.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Negotiated NB-N1 mode DRX parameters
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.7.38	Negotiated NB-N1 mode DRX parameters
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.7	Registration accept] 
The network shall include the Negotiated NB-N1 mode DRX parameters IE if the requested NB-N1 mode DRX parameters IE was included in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Negotiated WUS assistance information
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.7.39	Negotiated WUS assistance information
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.7	Registration accept] 
The network shall include the Negotiated WUS assistance information IE if:

-	the UE supports WUS assistance information;

-	the AMF supports and accepts the use of WUS assistance information;

-	the UE is not performing the initial registration for emergency services; and

-	the UE does not have an active emergency PDU session.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Extended rejected NSSAI
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.7.40	Extended rejected NSSAI
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.7	Registration accept] 
If the UE supports Extended rejected NSSAI, the network may include this IE to inform the UE of one or more S-NSSAIs that were included in the requested NSSAI in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message but were rejected by the network.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Service-level-AA container
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.7.41	Service-level-AA container
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.7	Registration accept] 
The network shall include this IE if the UUAA procedure is triggered for the UE supporting UAS services. The network may include this IE if there is a valid successful UUAA result for the UE in the UE 5GMM context upon a registration for UAS services is requested from the UE.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Negotiated PEIPS assistance information
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.7.42	Negotiated PEIPS assistance information
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.7	Registration accept] 
The network shall include the Negotiated PEIPS assistance information IE if the network needs to provide the PEIPS assistance information to the UE.

title: TS 24.501
heading: 5GS additional request result
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.7.43	5GS additional request result
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.7	Registration accept] 
The network may include this IE to inform the UE about the result of additional request.

title: TS 24.501
heading: NSSRG information
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.7.44	NSSRG information
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.7	Registration accept] 
This IE may be included to provide NSSRG information associated with the configured NSSAI.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Disaster roaming wait range
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.7.45	Disaster roaming wait range
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.7	Registration accept] 
This IE may be included to assign a new disaster roaming wait range to the UE.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Disaster return wait range
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.7.46	Disaster return wait range
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.7	Registration accept] 
This IE may be included to assign a new disaster return wait range to the UE.

title: TS 24.501
heading: List of PLMNs to be used in disaster condition
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.7.47	List of PLMNs to be used in disaster condition
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.7	Registration accept] 
This IE may be included by an allowed PLMN to assign a new "list of PLMN(s) to be used in disaster condition" associated with the serving PLMN to the UE.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Forbidden TAI(s) for the list of "5GS forbidden tracking areas for roaming"
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.7.48	Forbidden TAI(s) for the list of "5GS forbidden tracking areas for roaming"
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.7	Registration accept] 
This IE is included to indicate the forbidden TAI(s) to be stored in the list of "5GS forbidden tracking areas for roaming". This IE is included only if the message is sent via satellite NG-RAN access.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Forbidden TAI(s) for the list of "5GS forbidden tracking areas for regional provision of service"
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.7.49	Forbidden TAI(s) for the list of "5GS forbidden tracking areas for regional provision of service"
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.7	Registration accept] 
This IE is included to indicate the forbidden TAI(s) to be stored in the list of "5GS forbidden tracking areas for regional provision of service". This IE is included only if the message is sent via satellite NG-RAN access.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Extended CAG information list
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.7.50	Extended CAG information list
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.7	Registration accept] 
If the UE supports Extended CAG information list, the network may include this IE to assign a new "CAG information list" to the UE or delete the "CAG information list" at the UE side.

title: TS 24.501
heading: NSAG information
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.7.51	NSAG information
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.7	Registration accept] 
If the UE has set the NSAG bit to "NSAG supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message over 3GPP access, the network may include this IE to provide NSAG information to the UE. Otherwise, the network shall not include this IE (see the 'comprehension required' scheme in clause 11.2.5 of 3GPP TS 24.007 [11]).

title: TS 24.501
heading: Equivalent SNPNs
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.7.52	Equivalent SNPNs
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.7	Registration accept] 
This IE may be included in order to assign an equivalent SNPNs list to a UE, by an AMF of an SNPN.

title: TS 24.501
heading: NID
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.7.53	NID
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.7	Registration accept] 
This IE shall be included if the UE supports equivalent SNPNs and the serving SNPN changes.

title: TS 24.501
heading: General
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.7.54.1	General
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.7	Registration accept] [under: 8.2.7.54	Registration accept type 6 IE container] 
This information element may be included only if the network knows that the UE will not treat this IE as unknown 'comprehension required' IE. Otherwise, the network shall not include this IE (see the 'comprehension required' scheme in clause 11.2.5 of 3GPP TS 24.007 [11]).

In this version of the specification, only the transfer of the information elements specified in table 8.2.7.54.1.1 is supported in the Registration accept type 6 IE container information element in the present message. For the handling of an information element with an IEI not listed in table 8.2.7.54.1.1, i.e. with an IEI unknown in the Registration accept type 6 IE container information element, see clause 7.6.4.1.

Table 8.2.7.54.1.1: Information elements and IEIs for the Registration accept type 6 IE container

IEI | Information Element | Type/Reference | Presence | Format | Length

01 | Extended LADN information | Extended LADN information 9.11.3.96 | O | TLV-E | 15-1787

02 | S-NSSAI location validity information | S-NSSAI location validity information 9.11.3.100 | O | TLV-E | 17-38611

03 | Partially allowed NSSAI | Partial NSSAI 9.11.3.103 | O | TLV-E | 3-808

04 | Partially rejected NSSAI | Partial NSSAI 9.11.3.103 | O | TLV-E | 3-808

title: TS 24.501
heading: Extended LADN information
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.7.54.2	Extended LADN information
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.7	Registration accept] [under: 8.2.7.54	Registration accept type 6 IE container] 
The network shall include this IE if the UE supports LADN per DNN and S-NSSAI and there are valid LADN service area(s) for the subscribed DNN(s) of the UE and S-NSSAI associated with the LADN in the current registration area.

title: TS 24.501
heading: S-NSSAI location validity information
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.7.54.3	S-NSSAI location validity information
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.7	Registration accept] [under: 8.2.7.54	Registration accept type 6 IE container] 
The network may include this IE to update the S-NSSAI location validity information.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Partially allowed NSSAI
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.7.54.5	Partially allowed NSSAI
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.7	Registration accept] [under: 8.2.7.54	Registration accept type 6 IE container] 
The network may include this IE to assign a partially allowed NSSAI to the UE.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Partially rejected NSSAI
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.7.54.6	Partially rejected NSSAI
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.7	Registration accept] [under: 8.2.7.54	Registration accept type 6 IE container] 
The network may include this IE to assign a partially rejected NSSAI to the UE.

title: TS 24.501
heading: RAN timing synchronization
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.7.55	RAN timing synchronization
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.7	Registration accept] 
This IE may be included to provide information related to the RAN timing synchronization to a UE which has set the Reconnection to the network due to RAN timing synchronization status change (RANtiming) bit to "Reconnection to the network due to RAN timing synchronization status change supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Alternative NSSAI
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.7.56	Alternative NSSAI
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.7	Registration accept] 
The network may include this IE to provide the alternative NSSAI to the UE.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Discontinuous coverage maximum time offset
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.7.57	Discontinuous coverage maximum time offset
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.7	Registration accept] 
This IE may be included to provide the UE with a discontinuous coverage maximum time offset.

title: TS 24.501
heading: S-NSSAI time validity information
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.7.58	S-NSSAI time validity information
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.7	Registration accept] 
If the UE supports S-NSSAI time validity information, the network may include this IE to update the S-NSSAI time validity information.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Unavailability configuration
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.7.59	Unavailability configuration
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.7	Registration accept] 
The network should include this IE if the network needs to provide parameters related to unavailability period to the UE.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Feature authorization indication
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.7.60	Feature authorization indication
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.7	Registration accept] 
The network may include this IE to inform to the UE about the features for which the UE is authorized to use.

title: TS 24.501
heading: On-demand NSSAI
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.7.61	On-demand NSSAI
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.7	Registration accept] 
The network may include this IE to provide the on-demand NSSAI to the UE.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Access technology utilization control
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.7.62	Access technology utilization control
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.7	Registration accept] 
This IE is included to indicate the restricted access technology(s).

title: TS 24.501
heading: Negotiated LP-WUSPS assistance information
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.7.63	Negotiated LP-WUSPS assistance information
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.7	Registration accept] 
The network shall include the Negotiated LP-WUSPS assistance information IE if the network needs to provide the LP-WUSPS assistance information to the UE.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Message definition
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.8.1	Message definition
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.8	Registration complete] 
The REGISTRATION COMPLETE message is sent by the UE to the AMF. See table 8.2.8.1.1.

Message type:	REGISTRATION COMPLETE

Significance:	dual

Direction:	UE to network

Table 8.2.8.1.1: REGISTRATION COMPLETE message content

IEI | Information Element | Type/Reference | Presence | Format | Length

 | Extended protocol discriminator | Extended protocol discriminator 9.2 | M | V | 1

 | Security header type | Security header type 9.3 | M | V | 1/2

 | Spare half octet | Spare half octet 9.5 | M | V | 1/2

 | Registration complete message identity | Message type 9.7 | M | V | 1

73 | SOR transparent container | SOR transparent container 9.11.3.51 | O | TLV-E | 20

title: TS 24.501
heading: SOR transparent container
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.8.2	SOR transparent container
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.8	Registration complete] 
This IE may be sent by the UE. If this IE is sent, the contents of this IE indicates the UE acknowledgement of successful reception of the SOR transparent container IE in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message. This IE shall indicate the ME support of SOR-CMCI.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Message definition
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.9.1	Message definition
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.9	Registration reject] 
The REGISTRATION REJECT message is sent by the AMF to the UE. See table 8.2.9.1.1.

Message type:	REGISTRATION REJECT

Significance:	dual

Direction:	network to UE

Table 8.2.9.1.1: REGISTRATION REJECT message content

IEI | Information Element | Type/Reference | Presence | Format | Length

 | Extended protocol discriminator | Extended protocol discriminator 9.2 | M | V | 1

 | Security header type | Security header type 9.3 | M | V | 1/2

 | Spare half octet | Spare half octet 9.5 | M | V | 1/2

 | Registration reject message identity | Message type 9.7 | M | V | 1

 | 5GMM cause | 5GMM cause 9.11.3.2 | M | V | 1

5F | T3346 value | GPRS timer 2 9.11.2.4 | O | TLV | 3

16 | T3502 value | GPRS timer 2 9.11.2.4 | O | TLV | 3

78 | EAP message | EAP message 9.11.2.2 | O | TLV-E | 7-1503

69 | Rejected NSSAI | Rejected NSSAI 9.11.3.46 | O | TLV | 4-42

75 | CAG information list | CAG information list 9.11.3.18A | O | TLV-E | 3-n

68 | Extended rejected NSSAI | Extended rejected NSSAI 9.11.3.75 | O | TLV | 5-90

2C | Disaster return wait range | Registration wait range 9.11.3.84 | O | TLV | 4

title: TS 24.501
heading: T3502 value

TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.9.3	T3502 value
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.9	Registration reject]

heading: EAP message
text:

[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.9	Registration reject] 
EAP message IE is included if the REGISTRATION REJECT message is used to convey EAP-failure message.

heading: Rejected NSSAI

[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.9	Registration reject] 
The network may include this IE to inform the UE of one or more S-NSSAIs that were included in the requested NSSAI in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message but were rejected by the network.

title: TS 24.501
heading: CAG information list
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.9.6	CAG information list
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.9	Registration reject] 
This IE may be included to assign a new "CAG information list" to the UE or delete the "CAG information list" at the UE side.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Extended rejected NSSAI
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.9.7	Extended rejected NSSAI
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.9	Registration reject] 
If the UE supports Extended rejected NSSAI, the network may include this IE to inform the UE of one or more S-NSSAIs that were included in the requested NSSAI in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message but were rejected by the network.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Disaster return wait range
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.9.8	Disaster return wait range
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.9	Registration reject] 
This IE may be included to assign a new disaster return wait range to the UE.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Extended CAG information list
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.9.9	Extended CAG information list
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.9	Registration reject] 
If the UE supports Extended CAG information list, the network may include this IE to assign a new "CAG information list" to the UE or delete the "CAG information list" at the UE side.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Lower bound timer value
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.9.10	Lower bound timer value
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.9	Registration reject] 
The AMF may include this IE when the 5GMM cause is set to #78 "PLMN not allowed to operate at the present UE location", to provide a minimum time value for an entry added to the list of "PLMNs not allowed to operate at the present UE location".

title: TS 24.501
heading: Forbidden TAI(s) for the list of "5GS forbidden tracking areas for roaming"
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.9.11	Forbidden TAI(s) for the list of "5GS forbidden tracking areas for roaming"

This IE is included to indicate the forbidden TAI(s) to be stored in the list of "5GS forbidden tracking areas for roaming". This IE is included only if the message is sent via satellite NG-RAN access.

heading: Forbidden TAI(s) for the list of "5GS forbidden tracking areas for regional provision of service"

TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.9.12	Forbidden TAI(s) for the list of "5GS forbidden tracking areas for regional provision of service"

This IE is included to indicate the forbidden TAI(s) to be stored in the list of "5GS forbidden tracking areas for regional provision of service". This IE is included only if the message is sent via satellite NG-RAN access.

title: TS 24.501

TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.9.16	Access technology utilization control
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.9	Registration reject]

title: TS 24.501
heading: PDU session ID
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.10.2	PDU session ID
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.10	UL NAS transport] 
The UE shall include this IE when the Payload container type IE is set to "N1 SM information" or "CIoT user data.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Old PDU session ID
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.10.3	Old PDU session ID
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.10	UL NAS transport] 
The UE shall include this IE if the UL NAS TRANSPORT message transports a PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message upon receiving the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND message with the 5GSM cause IE set to #39 "reactivation requested" and the Payload container type IE is set to "N1 SM information".

title: TS 24.501
heading: Request type
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.10.4	Request type
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.10	UL NAS transport] 
The UE shall include this IE when the PDU session ID IE is included and the Payload container IE contains the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message or the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST which is not initiated to indicate a change of 3GPP PS data off UE status associated to a PDU session.

title: TS 24.501
heading: S-NSSAI
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.10.5	S-NSSAI
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.10	UL NAS transport] 
The UE may include this IE when the Request type IE is set to "initial request", "existing PDU session" or "MA PDU request", the Payload container type IE is set to "N1 SM information" and the UE is not registered for onboarding services in SNPN.

title: TS 24.501
heading: DNN
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.10.6	DNN
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.10	UL NAS transport] 
The UE may include this IE when the Request type IE is set to "initial request", "existing PDU session" or "MA PDU request", the Payload container type IE is set to "N1 SM information" and the UE is not registered for onboarding services in SNPN.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Additional information
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.10.7	Additional information
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.10	UL NAS transport] 
This IE is included when the Payload container type IE is set to "LTE Positioning Protocol (LPP) message container"or "SLPP message container". This IE may be included when the Payload container type IE is set to "Location services message container"or "UPP-CMI container".

title: TS 24.501
heading: MA PDU session information
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.10.8	MA PDU session information
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.10	UL NAS transport] 
The UE may include this IE if the Request type IE is included and is not set to "initial emergency request " or "existing emergency PDU session" in the UL NAS TRANSPORT message.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Release assistance indication
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.10.9	Release assistance indication
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.10	UL NAS transport] 
The UE may include this IE to inform the network whether:

-	no further uplink and no further downlink data transmission is expected; or

-	only a single downlink data transmission (e.g. acknowledgement or response to uplink data) and no further uplink data transmission subsequent to the uplink data transmission is expected.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Non-3GPP access path switching indication
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.10.10	Non-3GPP access path switching indication
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.10	UL NAS transport] 
The UE may include this IE when the Payload container type IE is set to "N1 SM information" to indicate whether the UE supports the non-3GPP access path switching for the PDU session.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Alternative S-NSSAI
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.10.11	Alternative S-NSSAI
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.10	UL NAS transport] 
The UE shall include this IE if the UE can provide alternative S-NSSAI associated with the S-NSSAI to be replaced to the network.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Payload container information
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.10.12	Payload container information
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.10	UL NAS transport] 
The UE may include this IE when the Payload container type IE is set to "Location services message container".

[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.11	DL NAS transport]

TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.11.5	Back-off timer value
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.11	DL NAS transport]

[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.19	Configuration update command] 
This IE may be included to assign a new full name for network to the UE.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Short name for network
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.19.8	Short name for network
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.19	Configuration update command] 
This IE may be included to assign a new short name for network to the UE.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Local time zone
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.19.9	Local time zone
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.19	Configuration update command] 
This IE may be included to assign a new local time zone to the UE.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Universal time and local time zone
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.19.10	Universal time and local time zone
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.19	Configuration update command] 
This IE may be included to assign new universal time and local time zone to the UE.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Network daylight saving time
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.19.11	Network daylight saving time
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.19	Configuration update command] 
This IE may be included to assign new network daylight saving time to the UE.

title: TS 24.501
heading: LADN information
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.19.12	LADN information
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.19	Configuration update command] 
This IE may be included to assign new LADN information to the UE or delete the LADN information at the UE side.

title: TS 24.501
heading: MICO indication
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.19.13	MICO indication
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.19	Configuration update command] 
This IE may be included to request the UE to re-negotiate MICO mode.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Network slicing indication
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.19.14	Network slicing indication
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.19	Configuration update command] 
This IE shall be included if the user's network slicing subscription has changed in the UDM of a PLMN or an SNPN.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Configured NSSAI
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.19.15	Configured NSSAI
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.19	Configuration update command] 
The AMF shall include this IE when the AMF needs to provide the UE with a new configured NSSAI for the current PLMN or SNPN and the UE is neither registering nor registered for onboarding services in SNPN.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Rejected NSSAI
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.19.16	Rejected NSSAI
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.19	Configuration update command] 
The network may include this IE to inform the UE of one or more S-NSSAIs that were previously sent to the UE in the allowed NSSAI or the pending NSSAI, but are now considered rejected by the network.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Operator-defined access category definitions
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.19.17	Operator-defined access category definitions
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.19	Configuration update command] 
This IE may be included to assign new operator-defined access category definitions to the UE or delete the operator-defined access category definitions at the UE side.

title: TS 24.501
heading: SMS indication
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.19.18	SMS indication
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.19	Configuration update command] 
This IE may be included to indicate that the ability for the UE to use SMS over NAS has changed.

title: TS 24.501
heading: T3447 value
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.19.19	T3447 value
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.19	Configuration update command] 
This IE may be included to assign a new T3447 value to the UE.

title: TS 24.501
heading: CAG information list
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.19.20	CAG information list
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.19	Configuration update command] 
This IE may be included to assign new "CAG information list" to the UE or delete the "CAG information list" at the UE side.

title: TS 24.501
heading: UE radio capability ID
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.19.21	UE radio capability ID
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.19	Configuration update command] 
This IE may be included if the UE is not in NB-N1 mode, both the UE and the network support RACS and the network needs to assign a network-assigned UE radio capability ID to the UE.

title: TS 24.501
heading: UE radio capability ID deletion indication
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.19.22	UE radio capability ID deletion indication
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.19	Configuration update command] 
This IE may be included if the UE is not in NB-N1 mode, both the UE and the network support RACS and the network needs to trigger the UE to delete all network-assigned UE radio capability IDs stored at the UE for the serving PLMN or serving SNPN.

title: TS 24.501
heading: 5GS registration result
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.19.23	5GS registration result
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.19	Configuration update command] 
This IE shall be included if the network wants to indicate to the UE that the UE is registered for emergency services.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Truncated 5G-S-TMSI configuration
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.19.24	Truncated 5G-S-TMSI configuration
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.19	Configuration update command] 
This IE may be included to provide a new truncated 5G-S-TMSI configuration to the UE in NB-N1 mode if the network is configured to provide the truncated 5G-S-TMSI configuration for control plane CIoT 5GS optimizations.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Additional configuration indication
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.19.25	Additional configuration indication
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.19	Configuration update command] 
The network may include this IE when requesting the UE to register without the release of the N1 NAS signalling connection.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Extended rejected NSSAI
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.19.26	Extended rejected NSSAI
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.19	Configuration update command] 
If the UE supports Extended rejected NSSAI, the network may include this IE to inform the UE of one or more S-NSSAIs that were previously sent to the UE in the allowed NSSAI or the pending NSSAI, but are now considered rejected by the network.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Service-level-AA container
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.19.27	Service-level-AA container
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.19	Configuration update command] 
The network shall include this IE when the AMF receives the Service-level-AA payload or the UUAA-MM result from the UAS-NF during the UUAA-MM procedure or the UUAA revocation procedure. The network shall also include this IE if the AMF receives from the UAS-NF, the CAA-level UAV ID as part of the UUAA-MM procedure.

title: TS 24.501
heading: NSSRG information
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.19.28	NSSRG information
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.19	Configuration update command] 
This IE may be included to provide NSSRG information associated with the configured NSSAI.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Disaster roaming wait range
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.19.29	Disaster roaming wait range
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.19	Configuration update command] 
This IE may be included to assign a new disaster roaming wait range to the UE.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Disaster return wait range
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.19.30	Disaster return wait range
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.19	Configuration update command] 
This IE may be included to assign a new disaster return wait range to the UE.

title: TS 24.501
heading: List of PLMNs to be used in disaster condition
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.19.31	List of PLMNs to be used in disaster condition
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.19	Configuration update command] 
This IE may be included by an allowed PLMN to assign a new "list of PLMN(s) to be used in disaster condition" associated with the serving PLMN to the UE.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Extended CAG information list
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.19.32	Extended CAG information list
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.19	Configuration update command] 
If the UE supports Extended CAG information list, the network may include this IE to assign a new "CAG information list" to the UE or delete the "CAG information list" at the UE side.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Updated PEIPS assistance information
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.19.33	Updated PEIPS assistance information
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.19	Configuration update command] 
The AMF may include this IE if the UE supports NR paging subgrouping, the AMF supports and accepts the use of PEIPIS assistance information for the UE, the UE is not registered for emergency services, the UE does not have an active emergency PDU session, and the network needs to update PEIPS assistance information for the UE.

title: TS 24.501
heading: NSAG information
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.19.34	NSAG information
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.19	Configuration update command] 
If the UE has set the NSAG bit to "NSAG supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message and the CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND message is sent over 3GPP access, the network may include this IE to provide NSAG information to the UE.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Priority indicator
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.19.35	Priority indicator
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.19	Configuration update command] 
The network shall include this IE when it needs to inform the UE that the use of access identity 1 is valid or is no longer valid.

title: TS 24.501
heading: RAN timing synchronization
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.19.36	RAN timing synchronization
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.19	Configuration update command] 
This IE may be included to provide information related to the RAN timing synchronization to a UE which has set the Reconnection to the network due to RAN timing synchronization status change (RANtiming) bit to "Reconnection to the network due to RAN timing synchronization status change supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Extended LADN information
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.19.37	Extended LADN information
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.19	Configuration update command] 
This IE may be included to assign new extended LADN information to the UE or delete the extended LADN information at the UE side.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Alternative NSSAI
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.19.38	Alternative NSSAI
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.19	Configuration update command] 
The network may include this IE to provide the mapping information between the S-NSSAI to be replaced and the alternative S-NSSAI to the UE.

title: TS 24.501
heading: S-NSSAI location validity information
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.19.39	S-NSSAI location validity information
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.19	Configuration update command] 
The network may include this IE to update the S-NSSAI location validity information.

title: TS 24.501
heading: S-NSSAI time validity information
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.19.40	S-NSSAI time validity information
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.19	Configuration update command] 
The network may include this IE to update the S-NSSAI time validity information.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Discontinuous coverage maximum time offset
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.19.41	Discontinuous coverage maximum time offset
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.19	Configuration update command] 
This IE may be included to provide the UE with a discontinuous coverage maximum time offset.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Partially allowed NSSAI
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.19.42	Partially allowed NSSAI
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.19	Configuration update command] 
The network may include this IE to assign a partially allowed NSSAI to the UE.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Partially rejected NSSAI
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.19.43	Partially rejected NSSAI
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.19	Configuration update command] 
The network may include this IE to assign a partially rejected NSSAI to the UE.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Feature authorization indication
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.19.44	Feature authorization indication
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.19	Configuration update command] 
The network may include this IE to inform to the UE about the features for which the UE is authorized to use.

title: TS 24.501
heading: On-demand NSSAI
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.19.45	On-demand NSSAI
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.19	Configuration update command] 
The network may include this IE to provide the on-demand NSSAI to the UE.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Access technology utilization control
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.19.46	Access technology utilization control
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.19	Configuration update command] 
This IE is included to indicate the restricted access technology(s).

title: TS 24.501
heading: Updated LP-WUSPS assistance information
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.19.47	Updated LP-WUSPS assistance information
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.19	Configuration update command] 
The AMF shall include this IE if the network needs to update the LP-WUSPS assistance information for the UE.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Message definition
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.20.1	Message definition
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.20	Configuration update complete] 
The CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMPLETE message is sent by the UE to the AMF. See table 8.2.20.1.1.

Message type:	CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMPLETE

Significance:	dual

Direction:	UE to network

Table 8.2.20.1.1: CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMPLETE message content

IEI | Information Element | Type/Reference | Presence | Format | Length

 | Extended protocol discriminator | Extended protocol discriminator 9.2 | M | V | 1

 | Security header type | Security header type 9.3 | M | V | 1/2

 | Spare half octet | Spare half octet 9.5 | M | V | 1/2

 | Configuration update complete message identity | Message type 9.7 | M | V | 1

title: TS 24.501
heading: Message definition
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.21.1	Message definition
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.21	Identity request] 
The IDENTITY REQUEST message is sent by the AMF to the UE to request the UE to provide specified identity. See table 8.2.21.1.1

Message type:	IDENTITY REQUEST

Significance:	dual

Direction:	AMF to UE

Table 8.2.21.1.1: IDENTITY REQUEST message content

IEI | Information Element | Type/Reference | Presence | Format | Length

 | Extended protocol discriminator | Extended protocol discriminator 9.2 | M | V | 1

 | Security header type | Security header type 9.3 | M | V | 1/2

 | Spare half octet | Spare half octet 9.5 | M | V | 1/2

 | Identity request message identity | Message type 9.7 | M | V | 1

 | Identity type | 5GS identity type 9.11.3.3 | M | V | 1/2

 | Spare half octet | Spare half octet 9.5 | M | V | 1/2

title: TS 24.501
heading: Message definition
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.22.1	Message definition
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.22	Identity response] 
The IDENTITY RESPONSE message is sent by the UE to the AMF to provide the requested identity. See table 8.2.22.1.

Message type:	IDENTITY RESPONSE

Significance:	dual

Direction:	UE to AMF

Table 8.2.22.1.1: IDENTITY RESPONSE message content

IEI | Information Element | Type/Reference | Presence | Format | Length

 | Extended protocol discriminator | Extended protocol discriminator 9.2 | M | V | 1

 | Security header type | Security header type 9.3 | M | V | 1/2

 | Spare half octet | Spare half octet 9.5 | M | V | 1/2

 | Identity response message identity | Message type 9.7 | M | V | 1

 | Mobile identity | 5GS mobile identity 9.11.3.4 | M | LV-E | 3-n

title: TS 24.501
heading: Message definition
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.23.1	Message definition
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.23	Notification] 
The NOTIFICATION message is sent by the AMF to the UE to notify the UE to initiate a service request procedure. See table 8.2.23.1.1.

Message type:	NOTIFICATION

Significance:	dual

Direction:	network to UE

Table 8.2.23.1.1: NOTIFICATION message content

IEI | Information Element | Type/Reference | Presence | Format | Length

 | Extended protocol discriminator | Extended protocol discriminator 9.2 | M | V | 1

 | Security header type | Security header type 9.3 | M | V | 1/2

 | Spare half octet | Spare half octet 9.5 | M | V | 1/2

 | Notification message identity | Message type 9.7 | M | V | 1

 | Access type | Access type 9.11.2.1A | M | V | 1/2

 | Spare half octet | Spare half octet 9.5 | M | V | 1/2

title: TS 24.501
heading: Message definition
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.24.1	Message definition
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.24	Notification response] 
The NOTIFICATION RESPONSE message is sent by the UE to the AMF to notify the failure to initiate the service request procedure as a response of notification. See table 8.2.24.1.1.

Message type:	NOTIFICATION RESPONSE

Significance:	dual

Direction:	UE to network

Table 8.2.2341.1: NOTIFICATION RESPONSE message content

IEI | Information Element | Type/Reference | Presence | Format | Length

 | Extended protocol discriminator | Extended protocol discriminator 9.2 | M | V | 1

 | Security header type | Security header type 9.3 | M | V | 1/2

 | Spare half octet | Spare half octet 9.5 | M | V | 1/2

 | Notification response message identity | Message type 9.7 | M | V | 1

50 | PDU session status | PDU session status 9.11.3.44 | O | TLV | 4-34

title: TS 24.501
heading: PDU session status
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.24.2	PDU session status
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.24	Notification response] 
This information element shall be included when the UE needs to indicate over non-3GPP access the PDU sessions that are associated with the 3GPP access type that are active within the UE.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Message definition
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.25.1	Message definition
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.25	Security mode command] 
The SECURITY MODE COMMAND message is sent by the AMF to the UE to establish NAS signalling security. See table 8.2.25.1.1.

Message type:	SECURITY MODE COMMAND

Significance:	dual

Direction:	network to UE

Table 8.2.25.1.1: SECURITY MODE COMMAND message content

IEI | Information Element | Type/Reference | Presence | Format | Length

 | Extended protocol discriminator | Extended protocol discriminator 9.2 | M | V | 1

 | Security header type | Security header type 9.3 | M | V | 1/2

 | Spare half octet | Spare half octet 9.5 | M | V | 1/2

 | Security mode command message identity | Message type 9.7 | M | V | 1

 | Selected NAS security algorithms | NAS security algorithms 9.11.3.34 | M | V | 1

 | ngKSI | NAS key set identifier 9.11.3.32 | M | V | 1/2

 | Spare half octet | Spare half octet 9.5 | M | V | 1/2

 | Replayed UE security capabilities | UE security capability 9.11.3.54 | M | LV | 3-9

E- | IMEISV request | IMEISV request 9.11.3.28 | O | TV | 1

57 | Selected EPS NAS security algorithms | EPS NAS security algorithms 9.11.3.25 | O | TV | 2

36 | Additional 5G security information | Additional 5G security information 9.11.3.12 | O | TLV | 3

78 | EAP message | EAP message 9.11.2.2 | O | TLV-E | 7-1503

38 | ABBA | ABBA 9.11.3.10 | O | TLV | 4-n

19 | Replayed S1 UE security capabilities | S1 UE security capability 9.11.3.48A | O | TLV | 4-7

55 | AUN3 device security key | AUN3 device security key 9.11.3.107 | O | TLV | 36-257

NOTE:	It is possible for AMFs compliant with version 18.3.0 or 18.3.1 of this specification to send the AUN3 device security key IE with a fixed length of 66 octets.

title: TS 24.501
heading: IMEISV request
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.25.2	IMEISV request
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.25	Security mode command] 
The AMF may include this information element to request the UE to send its IMEISV with the corresponding SECURITY MODE COMPLETE message.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Selected EPS NAS security algorithms
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.25.4	Selected EPS NAS security algorithms
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.25	Security mode command] 
This IE shall be included if the AMF supports N26 interface, the UE set the S1 mode bit to "S1 mode supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message, and the AMF needs to provide the selected EPS NAS security algorithms to the UE.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Additional 5G security information
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.25.5	Additional 5G security information
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.25	Security mode command] 
The network shall include this IE if:

a)	the network needs to provide the UE with horizontal derivation parameter; or

b)	the applicable initial NAS message (i.e. REGISTRATION REQUEST, CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST or SERVICE REQUEST) does not successfully pass the integrity check at the AMF (see clause 5.4.2.2).

title: TS 24.501
heading: EAP message
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.25.6	EAP message
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.25	Security mode command] 
This IE is included when the EAP Success message is sent as part of the EAP based primary authentication and key agreement procedure, as specified in clause 5.4.1.2.

title: TS 24.501
heading: ABBA
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.25.7	ABBA
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.25	Security mode command] 
This IE shall be included if the message contains an EAP message IE with an EAP-success message.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Replayed S1 UE security capabilities
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.25.8	Replayed S1 UE security capabilities
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.25	Security mode command] 
This IE shall be included if the Selected EPS NAS security algorithms information element is included.

title: TS 24.501
heading: AUN3 device security key
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.25.9	AUN3 device security key
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.25	Security mode command] 
This IE shall be included when the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message is provided to a 5G-RG that is acting on behalf of an AUN3 device if the EAP message IE is set to an EAP-success message.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Message definition
text:

heading: NAS message container
text:

[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.26	Security mode complete] 
The UE shall include this information element:

a)	if during an ongoing registration procedure or service request procedure, the AMF included the Additional 5G security information with the RINMR bit set to "Retransmission of the initial NAS message requested" in the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message as described in 3GPP TS 33.501 [24]; or

[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2	5GS mobility management messages] [under: 8.2.26	Security mode complete]

The UE shall include this information element, if the IMEISV was requested within the corresponding SECURITY MODE COMMAND message, the IMEISV is not available but EUI-64 is available.

title: TS 24.501
heading: CIoT small data container
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.30.2	CIoT small data container
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2.30	Control Plane Service request] 
This IE shall be included if the UE needs to send uplink small user data, SMS or location services message that is not more than 254 bytes, and there is no other optional IE to be sent.

NOTE:	When the UE determines to use the CIoT small data container IE to send uplink data in this message, there is no other optional IEs in this message.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Payload container type
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.30.3	Payload container type
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2.30	Control Plane Service request] 
This IE shall be included if the UE includes the Payload container IE.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Payload container
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.30.4	Payload container
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2.30	Control Plane Service request] 
This IE shall be included if the UE needs to send uplink CIoT user data, SMS or location services message.

title: TS 24.501
heading: PDU session ID
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.30.5	PDU session ID
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2.30	Control Plane Service request] 
The UE shall include this IE when the Payload container type IE is set to "CIoT user data container".

title: TS 24.501
heading: PDU session status
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.30.6	PDU session status
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2.30	Control Plane Service request] 
This IE shall be included when the UE needs to indicate the PDU sessions that are associated with the access type that the message is sent over, that are active within the UE.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Release assistance indication
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.30.7	Release assistance indication
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2.30	Control Plane Service request] 
The UE may include this IE to inform the network whether:

-	no further uplink and no further downlink data transmission is expected; or

-	only a single downlink data transmission (e.g. acknowledgement or response to uplink data) and no further uplink data transmission subsequent to the uplink data transmission is expected.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Uplink data status
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.30.8	Uplink data status
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2.30	Control Plane Service request] 
This IE shall be included if the UE has uplink user data pending to be sent over the user plane.

title: TS 24.501
heading: NAS message container
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.30.9	NAS message container
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2.30	Control Plane Service request] 
This IE shall be included if the UE is sending a CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message as an initial NAS message and the UE needs to send non-cleartext IEs.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Additional information
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.30.10	Additional information
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2.30	Control Plane Service request] 
The UE may include this IE when the Payload container type IE is set to "Location services message container".

title: TS 24.501
heading: Allowed PDU session status
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.30.11	Allowed PDU session status
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2.30	Control Plane Service request] 
This IE shall be included if the CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message is sent as a response to paging with the access type indicating non-3GPP access or notification via 3GPP access for PDU session(s) associated with non-3GPP access.

title: TS 24.501
heading: UE request type
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.30.12	UE request type
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2.30	Control Plane Service request] 
The UE shall include this IE if the MUSIM UE requests the release of the NAS signalling connection or rejects the paging request from the network.

title: TS 24.501
heading: Paging restriction
text:
TS 24.501 V19.7.0 | 8.2.30.13	Paging restriction
[under: 8	Message functional definitions and contents] [under: 8.2.30	Control Plane Service request] 
The UE shall include this IE if the Request type is set to "NAS signalling connection release" or to "Rejection of paging" in the UE request type IE and the UE requests the network to restrict paging.
